name: Windtotem the Elder
summary: Elder Windtotem is an honored ancestor spirit who appears on a bluff overlooking the goblin port of Ratchet during the Lunar Festival. Bathed in a radiant shaft of celestial light, she receives travelers seeking to honor the wisdom of ages past. Paying homage to her rewards mortals with an ancestral blessing and guidance toward other elders walking Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Vigil Over the Bay
sections.body: Perched on a grassy hill just northwest of the flight master in Ratchet, Elder Windtotem looks out over the bustling goblin docks and the open sea. While the harbor beneath her trades in iron, gunpowder, and coin, the elder stands apart in quiet contemplation, touched only by the quiet winds of the Barrens and the celestial glow descending from above.

sections.title: Wisdom Across the Barrens
sections.body: Like the other ancestral spirits summoned forth during the Lunar Festival, Elder Windtotem acts as a guide to wandering mortals. Those who seek her out not only earn her blessing and a token of her favor, but also receive whispers detailing the whereabouts of neighboring elders throughout the continent, including Elder Runetotem and Elder Bloodhoof.

faq.answer: Elder Windtotem stands on a hill directly northwest of the flight master in Ratchet, overlooking the harbor in the Barrens.

faq.q: What is the purpose of seeking out Elder Windtotem?
faq.answer: During the Lunar Festival, travelers seek out Elder Windtotem to pay their respects to an honored ancestor. In exchange for your homage, she grants a Coin of Ancestry and knowledge about where to find other spirits across the land.

faq.q: Why is there a beam of light shining down on her?
faq.answer: Each ancestor manifested during the Lunar Festival is bathed in a distinct pillar of celestial moonlight, signifying their ethereal presence and spiritual tether between the realm of ancestors and the living world.

faq.q: Can Alliance and Horde players both speak to Elder Windtotem?
faq.answer: Yes. Ratchet is a neutral port administered by the Steamwheedle Cartel, and the elders of the Lunar Festival impartially welcome members of both the Alliance and the Horde.

faq.q: Which other elders does Elder Windtotem tell you about?
faq.answer: Elder Windtotem shares rumors and guidance regarding several neighboring ancestors, including Elder Bloodhoof, Elder Runetotem, Elder Morningdew, Elder Darkhorn, Elder High Mountain, Elder Moonwarden, and Elder Wheathoof.

faq.q: What happens when you complete homage to the elder?
faq.answer: When you approach and honor her, she commends your spirit for burning brightly with life, accepts your respect, and rewards you with a Coin of Ancestry.

angles.text: The Windtotem lineage represents an ancient tauren heritage; honoring this ancestor above the goblin harbor connects modern tribesfolk directly to the ancestral memory of the plains.
The Lunar Festival and its ancestral apparitions celebrate deep communion with the natural and celestial cycles guarded by the Cenarion Circle.
Speaking to ancestor spirits who linger near elemental crossings reinforces the shamanic duty of honoring the dead and tending the spiritual health of the land.
